summary: A senator has committed to prioritizing D.C. statehood, while advocacy groups continue highlighting past federal interventions in the District—including a federal takeover and National Guard deployment—as reasons statehood is urgently needed. Additionally, D.C. Vote is urging House lawmakers to reject efforts that would undermine the District's fiscal independence. Without statehood, D.C. residents have no voting representation in Congress, and Congress can override any law the District passes.

articles.title: VIDEO: Senator Slotkin Commits to Making DC Statehood a Top Priority
One Year Later, DC Vote Says Federal Takeover Underscores the Urgency of DC Statehood
One Year After President Trump Deployed National Guard Troops to Washington, D.C., Statehood is More Important Than Ever
DC Vote Urges House Committee to Reject Sweeping Attack on DC’s Fiscal Independence
